title: Pinchoff by surface diffusion
summary: We construct surface diffusion flows $f:\mathbb{T}^2\times[0,T)\to\mathbb{R}^3$ that drive smooth closed embedded tori to pinchoff in finite time. The flow remains embedded for $t\in[0,T)$ and develops a curvature singularity only at a distinguished point $p$ as $t\nearrow T$. Away from $(p,T)$ the flow converges smoothly as $t\nearrow T$.
